item.title: Green Shield Research Fellowship 2027
item.description: The Green Shield Research Fellowship funds one-year climate research placements for graduate students. Application Deadline: 30 November 2026. Benefits include a monthly stipend and full travel coverage.

item.title: Remote Tech Bootcamp — rolling scholarships
item.description: This remote bootcamp keeps scholarship applications ongoing: admissions stay open year-round with monthly cohorts, and fees are waived for admitted students.

item.title: Community Data Volunteer Call
item.description: A local NGO looks for volunteers to clean and visualise public transport data. No deadline is published for this call.
